name: Lacusovagus
isnote: Has also been recovered within Thalassodromidae or Tapejaridae.
sum: ‘Grand lake wanderer’: the largest pterosaur of the Crato Formation, Brazil, known from a wide toothless upper jaw.
holotype: SMNK PAL 4325 — Nova Olinda Member, Crato Formation, Ceará.
material: Partial upper jaw (skull in front of the eyes).
biology: Unusually wide, crestless toothless skull; chaoyangopterids are thought to have foraged on the ground.
author: Witton 2008

species.name: Lacusovagus magnificens
species.author: Witton 2008
